decision.explanation: Both 'August 17, 2021' (supported by D1S1) and 'August 2021' (supported by D3S2) are valid answers based on direct evidence from the sources. They refer to the same event (the announcement of the Pixel 5a) at different granularities—specific date vs. month/year. Since they are not mutually exclusive and represent complementary levels of detail, both should be retained.
